async function craftIronSwordFromAvailableRawIron(bot) {
    // The function checks if an iron sword is already present in the inventory; if so, it stops. It ensures at least one stick is available, crafting one from jungle planks if necessary. It then determines how many iron ingots are needed and attempts to smelt raw iron using a nearby furnace, prioritizing jungle planks as fuel. If more ingots are required, it uses spare sticks as fuel. Finally, it verifies that two iron ingots and one stick are available before locating a crafting table and creating the iron sword.
}
